permit.applies: The person for whom the permit is sought, or someone on their behalf, files with the Labour Department's Employment Service, with the intended employer's statement (the Second Schedule form) unless self-employed; the Minister decides on the Chief of the Employment Service's report.
permit.first: The intended employer's statement; the Employment Service investigates the effect of the grant on employment opportunities open to citizens.

fees.what: Application or renewal fee (Labour Code s. F5(2), as amended by Act No. 13 of 2020)

sources.title: Laws of Antigua and Barbuda, Cap. 27, Labour Code, Division F (Work Permits)
sources.said: Application for a work permit, or its renewal or extension, shall be made by or on behalf of the person for whom the work permit is sought by the filing, with the Employment Service of the Labour Department, of an application in the form prescribed in the First Schedule … he shall take into consideration, among other things, the effect of the grant upon employment … There shall be paid by any person granted a work permit such fee as shall be prescribed by the Minister by Order.

sources.title: Antigua and Barbuda Labour Code (Amendment) Act 2020, No. 13 of 2020 (Official Gazette Vol. XL No. 44, 17 June 2020), FAOLEX copy
sources.said: in subsection (2) be repealing the words “ten dollars” and substituting therefor the words “one hundred dollars”.
